decisions: TSIG HMAC authenticates transaction/integrity using explicitly shared secrets; not encryption,RRSIG generation,or permission grant. Valid unauthorized UPDATE REFUSED with signed response. Known-key MAC failure NOTAUTH/TSIG BADSIG16 unsigned response.
Secondary serves signed records without signing private key. NOTIFY not transfer; complete checked IXFR or AXFR-style fallback installed atomically.

ZONEMD authenticate expected apex SOA/ZONEMD signatures through anchor; verify matching serial,scheme/hash,digest length and computed whole-zone digest. Individually valid RRsets do not establish whole-zone completeness. SIMPLE excludes apex ZONEMD and its covering signatures; includes other DNSSEC data.
